title: Gyeonggi Art Collective Founding General Meeting
description:
The founding general meeting marking the official launch of the Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative was held successfully. At this gathering, the cooperative's vision and goals were shared, and participants had the opportunity to meet fellow members.

### Event Overview

This meaningful occasion marked a new starting point for artists' independence and mutual growth. Concrete plans for sustaining artistic creation and developing the arts ecosystem were discussed.

### Key Highlights
- Announcement of the cooperative's founding mission and vision
- Member introductions and networking
- Sharing of future activity plans

title: Gyeonggi Art Collective Opening Party
description:
The opening party of the Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative — a producer cooperative aimed at supporting artists in Gyeonggi Province and revitalizing the cultural arts ecosystem — came to a successful close!

Many people gathered to celebrate the first steps of Gyeonggi Art Collective, which strives to promote the sustainability of artistic creation and contribute to local cultural arts development through autonomous, self-reliant, and self-governing cooperative activities.

### About the Cooperative

The Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative is a producer cooperative that supports artists in Gyeonggi Province, promotes the sustainability of artistic creation, and contributes to the revitalization of local cultural arts. We carry out diverse activities including arts support programs, music production and distribution, concert planning and management, and cultural arts education. Established on May 1, 2025, this cooperative pursues a transparent and democratic arts ecosystem built together by creator, producer, supporting, and institutional members.

The Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative is committed to transparent and democratic operation, and will continuously strive for the benefit of its members and the development of local cultural arts. We invite your interest and participation in our journey to build a community that grows together with the arts. We welcome artists, local residents, and everyone with an interest in cultural arts.

- themilliways
- Yoo Dong-hyuk
- Panzerkorps
- Sabbaha

title: Suwon Acme Studio Housewarming Networking Sketch
description:
On June 7th, we joined many artist members for the housewarming of Acme Studio in Suwon. It was a meaningful occasion to celebrate the opening of a new creative space and to network, exchanging warm greetings with one another.

### A Warm Gathering

From the moment you stepped through the door, Acme Studio was filled with warmth and energy. Sincere conversations flowed over delicious food, and throughout the studio, laughter never ceased — even among those meeting for the first time.

### A Precious Exchange Among Artists

This housewarming went beyond simply introducing a new space; it was a valuable gathering where artists from various fields centered around Suwon came together to share their work and explore new possibilities for collaboration. Our Gyeonggi Art Collective members also had a precious time forming new connections and exchanging creative inspiration.

### Support and Encouragement

We sincerely congratulate the birth of yet another wonderful arts hub in Suwon, and we cheer on Acme Studio to become a space where countless artistic sparks and stories continue to bloom.

Gyeonggi Art Collective will continue to create diverse opportunities for members and local artists to communicate and grow together.

title: Visit to Composer-for-Hire Kim Dongsan's Recording Studio
description:
A visit was made to the special recording studio newly pioneered by composer-for-hire Kim Dongsan, located across from the cultural space Longplayer near Jangan Gate in Suwon.

### Longplayer and Kim Dongsan

Longplayer is a unique cultural space located near Jangan Gate in Suwon, operated by the well-known composer-for-hire Kim Dongsan. It serves as a creative hub where music and culture intersect in the Suwon region.

### The Appeal of Tape Recording

The most distinctive feature of the studio visited was its capability for tape recording. Analog tape recording provides a unique warmth and depth, adding a special texture and atmosphere to music.

### Visit Participants

From the Gyeonggi Art Collective Cooperative, Hwang Gyeong-ha, Choi Gita, Zsthyger, and Lee Ho-min participated in this visit. Drawing on their individual musical experiences and perspectives, they enjoyed samgyeopsal together, toured Kim Dongsan's studio, and shared a variety of stories.

### Discussion of Collaboration Possibilities

During the visit, there were also discussions about future recording collaboration possibilities with ACME Studio in Suwon's Ingye-dong — a space where drum recording is possible, in which Zsthyger is involved in operations. It would be wonderful if complementary collaboration drawing on each studio's unique characteristics could be realized.

### Future Plans

We look forward to continued exchange and collaboration between Gyeonggi Art Collective and Longplayer. We hope that through vigorous creative activities utilizing various recording environments, even richer musical output can be produced.

title: Health Concert (健康列傳) (Cancelled due to health reasons)
description:
(Cancelled due to health reasons)

A special music concert, 'Health Concert (健康列傳),' had been scheduled for Thursday, September 18th at 7 PM at 'Longplayer,' a vintage LP bar and café in Paldal-gu, Suwon, but was cancelled due to health issues.

The title 'Health Concert' carries the meaning that artists of diverse musical colors gather to wish the hearts and bodies of the audience good health. The subtitle 'Play long the long play' expressed the intent to deliver music with a lingering resonance like an LP record, inspired by the character of the venue, Longplayer.

### Artist Introductions

**Heewoo**
A singer-songwriter with a distinctive style that incorporates traditional pansori vocal techniques into contemporary music. Combining the deep emotional expression of pansori with modern arrangements, Heewoo presents music that bridges tradition and the present day. His music, which reinterprets the sounds of traditional instruments such as daegeum and gayageum in a modern context, delivers emotion that transcends time.

**Yoo Dong-hyuk**
A musician who began with punk rock and forged a unique genre called punk-folk. Through life's turning points, he works through his experiences of loss and wandering with an acoustic guitar, conveying a rough yet warm sensibility. The years of struggle and pain are woven throughout his music.

**themilliways**
A solo project by musician Ju Jintae, pursuing experimental soundscapes rooted in ambient and post-rock. Having begun composing in the early 2000s and standing in solidarity with various social movements, he has continued original work at the intersection of music and media, drawing on his experience as a content producer at Seo Taiji Company. Following a terminal lung cancer diagnosis in 2017 and a period of recovery, he made his solo debut in 2021, and his music carries profound messages exploring existence and the inner self.

**Yamagata Tweakster**
A unique performance artist who calls himself a 'Mutugayo People's Entertainer.' Active in the Hongdae area since 2008, he communicates with audiences through Hanba's performances combining dance and song to dance music. Beyond club performances, he actively delivers social messages through music by standing in solidarity at various protest sites.

### Concert Information

- **Date**: Thursday, September 18, 2025, 7 PM
- **Venue**: Longplayer, Suwon (Vintage LP bar/café)
- **Admission**: Advance/Door 15,000 KRW (includes drink discount)
- **Discount**: 5,000 KRW discount for Gyeonggi Art Collective members

### Venue

Longplayer, where the concert was to take place, is a space where music and analog culture can be enjoyed through records, cameras, and drip coffee. Known for a culture of repairing and reusing things that become discarded over time, it is a special place where anyone can come, listen to the records of their choice, and summon memories through music-related memorabilia.

The stage of healing and comfort offered by four groups of artists who have each walked their own musical journeys was expected to bring musical wellness to many this autumn.

title: Ancestral Exorcism Public Service 祖上退魔 公共役務
description:
An experimental indie concert by 6 acts that dismantles the shackles of tradition and custom through music. A therapeutic musical experience that liberates you from the unconscious dominion of ancestors.

To: Audience members  
Re: Notice of the Ancestral Exorcism Public Service Concert

Wishing you good health.

We hereby inform you of the following comprehensive genre indie music concert for your review and reference.

- Details Below -

Concert Name: Ancestral Exorcism Public Service

### Artistic Intent
We live in the present, worrying about an uncertain future, and sometimes falling into depression. Yet the past is absolutely certain, and we can never escape its shackles.

Ancestors remain in our bloodlines, endlessly binding us to ethnicity and cultural tradition, dominating our unconscious. The ceremonies of praise, rites, and ancestral rites dedicated to ancestors — the unconscious rulers bearing the name of ancestry — sometimes reinforce systems under the guise of Confucian culture, and sometimes become mirrors that project our vain desires.

The Ancestral Exorcism Public Service provides music that shatters these mirrors and forcibly dismantles these systems. Through this service — which the state and society cannot provide — audiences either heal memories of suffering bound to ancestors and roots, or participate in a ritual that exorcises the very concept of ancestry itself.

description:

On Sunday night, November 9th, at the live club d.o.t in Haenggung-dong, Suwon, singer-songwriter **Yoo Dong-hyuk** — who has evolved into punk-folk — sits face to face with **Kim Dongsan and the Blueighbors**, a blues collective standing on the side of life. Come witness the moment the sharp energy of punk, the lyricism of folk, and the warm consolation of blues intersect on one stage.

### Performers

- Yoo Dong-hyuk — A 'punk-folk' artist formerly of punk rock band 'Yokai Ingan,' now singing about people's lives through an acoustic guitar after loss
- Kim Dongsan and the Blueighbors — A band where composer-for-hire Kim Dongsan unfolds the stories of neighbors through blues

- Venue: Live Club d.o.t in Haenggung-dong, Paldal-gu, Suwon, Gyeonggi-do
- Tickets: Advance 15,000 KRW / Door 20,000 KRW

- **Quorum**: Attendance of a majority of enrolled members (Framework Act on Cooperatives, Article 29)
- **Resolution Quorum**: Majority vote of attending members (except for amendments to articles of incorporation, dissolution, merger, etc., which require a 2/3 majority of attending members)
- **Voting Rights**: One vote per person (regardless of number of shares held)

### Reports

- Report No. 1 | FY2025 (1st Term) Business Report
- Report No. 2 | FY2025 (1st Term) Audit Report

### Agenda Items

- Agenda No. 1 | Approval of FY2025 (1st Term) Financial Statements
- Agenda No. 2 | Approval of FY2026 (2nd Term) Business Plan
- Agenda No. 3 | Approval of FY2026 (2nd Term) Revenue and Expenditure Budget
- Agenda No. 4 | Ratification of resignation of 3 directors and election of new directors
- Agenda No. 5 | Approval of maximum borrowing limit

### Concurrent Program

A members' networking party will follow in the same venue after the meeting closes. This is an opportunity for members to connect and discuss collaboration, so we encourage everyone's participation.

title: Suwon Sound Market Vol.2 — Play and Sell Instruments
description:
🎸 Suwon Sound Market Vol.2: "Polish It, Tighten It, Oil It Up!"

There are few things in this world that don't taste good when chewed — and even fewer objects that don't make a sound when hit.

Strike someone's back with a back-scratcher and you'll hear a satisfying thwack. Hurl a stainless tumbler from the district office onto the floor and a clear tone rings out. What matters is how hard you hit it and how far you throw it.

Back-scratchers, tumblers, whatever mysterious object you have — bring it. On this day, polish it with care, tighten every bolt, and oil it up before you arrive.

Gyeonggi Art Collective has prepared a marketplace for those who've lost their touch — where instruments (or things that will soon be treated as instruments) are shared, loud conversations are had, lubricant is consumed, and every kind of sound is exchanged.

## 🛠️ When & Where?

📅 **Date:** Sunday, June 21, 2026 · 14:00–19:00

📍 **Venue:** [DOT](https://naver.me/x7GFCg6V) (B1F, 34-1 Hwaseomun-ro, Paldal-gu, Suwon)

💰 **Admission:** Free for everyone!

## ⚙️ How Does It Work?

**[Part 1] Flea Market (14:00~17:00)**

Stalls line up selling things that make sounds — or things that will soon become instruments. Workshops happen. Enjoy the air conditioning at your leisure.

**[Part 2] Bundle Auction (17:00~19:00)**

Musicians from near and far take the stage. Watch acts complete their setup, PR, performance, item showcase, and self-auction — all within 15 minutes.

## ⚠️ Requirements for Sellers & Musicians

**Part 1 participants** get a 3-hour stall. Run a lesson or workshop, sell coffee or dumplings, or just sit and stare at your open laptop — as long as it's interesting, you're in. No booth fee.

**Part 2 participants** get 15 minutes. (Setup included!) Use it for a performance, auction, self-promotion, feats of skill — go wild! No participation fee.

You **must bring at least 1 item** to sell — tangible or intangible, goods or labor. It's genuinely hard to find objects that don't make a sound when hit. At Vol.1 we had milk, leftover coffee beans, accessories, and people selling themselves as servants.

**10% Solidarity:** We collect 10% of on-site sales as a voluntary contribution. This goes toward the after-party, staff appreciation, and general cleanup.

## 📦 What Can You Sell?

- **Things that already make sounds (or will):** guitars, effects pedals, mics, cables, instrument-shaped toys, green tea bags, nail clippers, fresh-baked cookies…
- **Things that help sounds happen indirectly:** DAW licenses, sample packs, WD-40 for broken mixers…
- **Things that help the humans who make sounds:** guitar lesson coupons, carpool passes, restaurant guides, Tylenol, moral support… (all forms of labor welcome)
- **Anything else you can justify!**

## 🚨 Notes

- Part 2 acts get **15 minutes** per team. **Setup included!**
- There's no guarantee your items will sell. Set prices low and bring a reasonable amount. (Items priced under ₩10,000 tend to move.)
- No refunds or returns after purchase or sale.

title: 🎚️ Home Recording Mixing Workshop
description:
🎚️ Home Recording Mixing Workshop

You managed to record at home — but froze the moment it came to mixing?

Sound engineers and musicians of Gyeonggi Art Collective gather to share their home-recording and mixing know-how. From gain staging to taming EQ and compressors, pulling vocals to the front, and monitoring that's slightly-less-wrong in a small room — this is a place to trade the hands-on tricks people actually use, not textbook theory.

Less a lecture handing out the "right answers," more a mutual-aid session where we open up each other's projects and share "here's how I do it." Bring a track you're working on — we'll listen and tweak it together.

## 🗓️ When & Where?

📅 **Date:** Saturday, June 27, 2026 · 4:00 PM

📍 **Venue:** Yeongtong-gu, Suwon, Gyeonggi (exact address shared with registrants)

💰 **Fee:** ₩20,000 (free for cooperative members)

## 🎧 What We'll Share

- Home recording setup: interface, mic, and room conditions
- Gain staging and keeping tracks tidy before they get messy
- EQ and compressor fundamentals, applied in practice
- Balancing vocals, guitars, and drums
- Using references and building a monitoring environment
- Working through sticking points together (Q&A)

## 🙆 Who It's For

- Anyone who can record but always gets stuck at mixing
- Anyone wondering why their song sounds "homemade"
- Anyone who wants to watch how others work, over the shoulder
- Members who want a relaxed way to connect with fellow sound/music folks

## 📌 Notes

- Bringing a laptop and headphones helps with the hands-on part. (You can join without them.)
- If you have a track in progress (stems or project file), we'll listen together.
- Seats are limited and may close on a first-come basis.
- Details will be sent to the contact you provide when applying.

title: 📦 themilliways Farewell Yard Sale
description:
